tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the Linkbreakers help center, guides, integrations and product news, the public QR code design templates or the public page theme templates. Returns ranked results with their URL, Markdown URL and a snippet; read a help article in full with get_article.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Return the full Markdown of a Linkbreakers help center article by slug (the last segment of https://linkbreakers.com/help/article/<slug>).

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Return the current Linkbreakers plans with prices in USD per month, plan limits, signup links, how to reach sales for Enterprise, and the features included in every plan with the help article that explains each.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_docs" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search the Linkbreakers help center, guides, integrations and product news, or the public QR code design templates. Returns ranked results with their URL, Markdown URL and a snippet; read a help article in full with get_article." → after: "Search the Linkbreakers help center, guides, integrations and product news, the public QR code design templates or the public page theme templates. Returns ranked results with their URL, Markdown URL and a snippet; read a help article in full with get_article."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
